pages.title: Shared parts of a window
pages.text: Tabs sit on the left and right edges; the close button and pin sit at the left of the title bar, and dragging the title bar moves the window. The vertical strip is the energy bar (hover for exact FE), and the progress bar tooltip says what is being processed and what is missing.

pages.title: Redstone control
pages.text: Four modes cycle: Ignored, High, Low and Pulse. Ignored is the default. Leaving it on High or Low and forgetting to wire redstone is the most common cause of "the machine has power but does nothing".

pages.title: The side configuration window
pages.text: Click the topmost tab on the left of the machine window (block icon). The type tabs at the top switch between items, fluids, energy, heat and chemicals, and each type keeps its own set of six faces. The six face buttons are laid out as an unfolded cube: left-click advances a face, Shift+left-click steps back.

pages.title: The four face states
pages.text: None seals the face, Input lets content in, Output lets the machine emit, and Input/Output allows both. Colours are only a hint; the text on the button is what counts. The button at the bottom right clears the current type (Shift-click clears every type).

pages.title: Auto-eject
pages.text: The 14x14 button at the top right of side configuration toggles auto-eject for the current type. Note that setting a face to Output does not make the machine push by itself: you still need auto-eject, a pulling pipe, or this addon's direct-transfer buttons.

pages.title: Apiary buttons
pages.text: All of them are 14x14 grey squares with a letter that turns green when on. Left column: A = AE output, M = direct AE output, O = direct container output. Right column: Mekanism's native auto-eject, D = centrifuge direct link, P = centrifuge priority. A/M/P exist only with AE2 installed.

pages.title: Centrifuge buttons
pages.text: Left column top to bottom: A = AE output, I = open the AE2 input window, F = power furnace recipe compatibility, A = direct AE output, O = direct container output. The top of the right column is Mekanism's native auto-eject. A and I exist only with AE2 installed.

pages.title: Window positions
pages.text: The Feeder, Multi-Fluid Tanks, PB Upgrade and AE2 Input windows remember their position and pinned state. If one disappears after changing resolution or GUI scale, open Client Settings, then Custom Window Positions, and reset that window instead of deleting the whole configuration.
